pages.title: Wenyao
pages.text: The Fengyang Classic records: shaped like a carp, with a fish's body and a bird's wings, adorned in azure patterns, white-headed with a crimson beak. It flies by night, swimming from the Western Sea to the Eastern Sea, breathing water as its air.

pages.title: Traits
pages.text: $(li)Hold jump to rise slowly$(li)Drift gently down when released$(li)Immune to fall damage$(br)In water:$(li)Breathe freely$(li)Swim swiftly$(br)On land:$(li)Moves with great difficulty$(li)Cannot breathe — return to water quickly.

pages.title: Lore
pages.text: The Wenyao is known for flying by night across the Western Sea to swim the Eastern. Clumsy on land, gasping once out of water — yet once it enters the sea, no net can ever catch it. $(br)Its appearance heralds abundance: where it flies, fish grow fat, rice ripens, and people live in peace.
